newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan sells 3.595 bln rupees bonds in operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan sells 3.595 bln rupees bonds in operation.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned short-term federal bonds worth a total of 3.595 billion rupee in a special open market operation on Wednesday..
It said bids worth 4.895 billion rupees were submitted by banks but only 3.595 billion rupees were accepted for the outright sale of the six-month bonds at a maximum cut-off of 15 percent per annum.
In the previous operation held on November 14, bids worth 3.68 billion rupees were submitted, out of which bids worth 2.88 billion rupees were accepted.
